faqs.q: How much does it cost to paint a house in Summit Pointe?
faqs.a: VIP exterior work starts at $4.75 per square foot of paintable surface, against a local market of roughly $2.74 to $4.89. Summit Pointe lots run about 3,400 to just over 7,000 square feet, so paintable surface is measured on site rather than assumed. Every estimate is itemized — preparation, primer, coating, trim and accents priced separately. Call (909) 312-5400.

faqs.q: My home still has the original 1991 colors. Is that a problem?
faqs.a: It is the most common situation in Summit Pointe and it is not a problem — it is an opportunity most owners underuse. A repaint that simply refreshes the builder palette costs almost exactly the same as one that changes it. Since you are paying for the preparation and the coating either way, the only question worth asking is whether the color is the one you actually want for the next eight years.

faqs.q: Do the panoramic views change how I should choose a color?
faqs.a: They change who sees it. Many Summit Pointe homes have 180-degree exposure, which means the front of your house is visible from well beyond your own street. Colors that read as subtle from the driveway can read very differently at distance, so we render the whole front of the house rather than showing you a close-up swatch.

faqs.q: Can you work inside a guard-gated community?
faqs.a: Yes. Summit Pointe is guard-gated, and we handle gate clearance for the crew and any deliveries as part of scheduling — vehicle details and crew names provided in advance, so nothing arrives unannounced at the gate. Materials are staged on your property, not on the street.

faqs.q: What coatings do you use?
faqs.a: Sherwin-Williams Emerald and Duration exterior systems, two coats at the full thickness the manufacturer specifies, sprayed and back-rolled on stucco with Graco and Titan airless equipment. Anaheim Hills sits on open slopes with long afternoon sun, which is hard on coatings — builder-grade paint chalks and fades years early up here. All work carries a 2-Year Warranty on labor and materials.

context.intro: Belsomet is small — around a hundred homes behind the gate, on Bridgewood Drive and the courts and circles off it. On a community that size, a repaint is not a private decision. Every neighbor sees it, and it visibly resets what the standard looks like.
context.hoaNote: Belsomet runs under a community association. We prepare the design review package as part of the project, working from your association's current guidelines rather than assumptions.

faqs.q: How much does it cost to paint a house in Belsomet?
faqs.a: VIP exterior work starts at $4.75 per square foot of paintable surface, against a local market of roughly $2.74 to $4.89. Belsomet parcels run about 3,000 to 4,200 square feet, so homes here are closer together and paintable surface is measured on site. Every estimate is itemized — preparation, primer, coating, trim and accents priced separately. Call (909) 312-5400.

faqs.q: The homes are close together. Is overspray a risk?
faqs.a: It is the risk worth taking seriously in Belsomet, and it is a containment question rather than a spraying question. On parcels of this size we mask and shield to the property line, protect neighboring vehicles, walls and planting, and schedule spray work around wind rather than against it. Back-rolling on stucco also puts the coating into the texture rather than leaving it airborne.

faqs.q: My home was built in 1993 and has never been fully repainted. Where do we start?
faqs.a: With the surface underneath, not the color. After three decades, hairline stucco cracking is normal and does not mean anything structural is wrong — but every crack has to be opened, filled and floated to match the surrounding texture or it telegraphs through the new coating within a season. Anywhere the original coating has chalked or failed needs bonding primer before topcoat. That work is what decides whether the finish lasts eight years or three.

faqs.q: Do the canyon and city-light views affect color choice?
faqs.a: They affect when the house is seen. Belsomet homes catch canyon and mountain light through the day and city lights after dark, so a color is being judged across a much wider range of conditions than a flat inland street. We render the front of your house rather than relying on a swatch chosen indoors.

faqs.q: Can you get a crew through the gate?
faqs.a: Yes. Belsomet is guard-gated. Vehicle details and crew names go to the gate in advance and deliveries are scheduled, so nothing arrives unannounced. Materials stage on your property rather than on the street.
